CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2664 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 1270ba9b92e16143ddabab30c8ad89138a4b4cc5. Bus nonce: bea9efccc3fe0bb4d989e52430c50d88. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 1270ba9b92e16143ddabab30c8ad89138a4b4cc5`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 1270ba9b92e16143ddabab30c8ad89138a4b4cc5` or `Fix review: blocked 1270ba9b92e16143ddabab30c8ad89138a4b4cc5 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: bea9efccc3fe0bb4d989e52430c50d88`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `1270ba9b92e16143ddabab30c8ad89138a4b4cc5` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2664 1270ba9b92e16143ddabab30c8ad89138a4b4cc5") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2664-bea9efcc`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2664, R10-FLY-RELAY-REVIEW-FF (lane F, size S, instrument), branch fix/r10-fly-relay-review-ff, head 1270ba9b92e16143ddabab30c8ad89138a4b4cc5. The code head is af21edb9e6e6; 1270ba9b adds only the delivery row. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head. Your ev/ MUST contain ev/HEAD.txt holding the full 40-hex head, or the relay refuses the verdict.

The PR adds a confirm arm to cloud_relay.sh `pass --confirm`. For each review/<pr> tip the relay pushed (bus-nonce matched to a probe the relay ledgered) that bus.sh has not posted (posted-signed `<pr> <tree>`), it runs `bus.sh confirm` with bounded retries. It prints POSTED on success, and OWED with the last stderr line on failure. Also: a non-fast-forward review/<N> re-apply, tick_loop relay_start passing --confirm, and probe_arm retrying transients.

Verify adversarially, with the finder's harness, not the fixer's:
(1) Three-dot diff `git diff $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)...HEAD`: every file is in the group's file list or is a test or fixture for it, plus INSTRUMENTS.md and dev/programme/delivery/2664.md.
(2) Rebuild the P-O failure: a relayed probe whose confirm failed, then the next pass. On main it says 'already relayed' and posts nothing. At the head it retries and logs POSTED. Null controls: an already-posted review does nothing and makes no confirm call; an undispatched review logs OWED once and not every pass.
(3) The three causes the body claims to cover: a failed confirm, a stale script, and a relay with no --confirm. Show each one is covered, or block naming the one that is not.
(4) Mutants: drop the arm, drop the posted check, drop the retry bound. Each must turn a test red. Check that no gh call was added (grep the diff).
(5) The non-fast-forward path never force-pushes, and probe_arm's REFUSED logging writes no .refused for a transient error.
(6) Every figure in the body at this head. `git merge-tree --write-tree` against origin/main is clean. Read CI with one bulk check-runs call. The commits carry no footers. Record the scoped-gate MODE line.
ORCH-LEDGER (unmerged) and UPDATE-PR-SIGNALS also edit cloud_relay.sh. Note any hunk overlap as a Carry, not a block.
Rules: PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1; spare the GitHub API; no Claude footers.
